• The Self and the Not-Self**
This episode from the *Upanishad Ganga* series delves into the fundamental teachings of Vedanta, emphasizing the distinction between the eternal *Atma* (Self) and the transient *Anatma* (Not-Self). It highlights the profound realization that our true essence is the Atma-unchanging, immortal, and beyond the material realm.
